principles.productTreatment: peer products within clear families; no product gets a special homepage hierarchy
principles.imageStrategy: every product reserves a premium visual slot for interface imagery, branded renders, device mockups, or relevant editorial photography; no generic stock placeholders
principles.publishRule: only expose products whose current route and current revision are verified
principles.commerceRule: paid products may be publicly marketed but their full application/content route must fail closed until canonical checkout and verified entitlement are connected
principles.directRouteRule: a paid product route is not considered protected merely because its link is hidden from navigation
